name: Air coolers and cooling towers
principle: Air coolers pass hot process fluid through finned tubes cooled by fan-driven air; cooling towers reject heat by evaporating water. Both remove process heat when cooling water or low ambient air is the sink.

process_steps.name: Hot process fluid enters finned tube bundle or tower fill
Fans move air across tubes or tower fill
Heat rejected to air; evaporation in a tower
Cooled fluid returns to the process
